fusions.name: Bitter Seed
fusions.desc: Drops a seed that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rooting Descent
fusions.desc: Drives down roots that deal 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stun them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Sown Glade
fusions.desc: Raises a growth where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Seed on the Wind
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
